name: u1-chamber-cooling
title: U1 Chamber Cooling
author: bespoked
description: Sets the Snapmaker U1 top cover's chamber cooling from the materials you print. For PLA, PETG and TPU the stock start G-code cools the chamber to a fixed 42 C (45 C on weak cooling), whatever you print. This plugin reads the softening temperature of every material the print uses from the print file, takes the lowest, and sets the cooling target, the alarm and the lowest exhaust speed from it and from the fan level you pick. ABS and ASA prints, which keep the chamber warm, are left as they are.
tagline: Chamber cooling set by your materials' softening temperature.

variables.name: FAN_LEVEL
variables.description: Fan level, one of 0, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 1. 0 cools hardest and is loudest, 1 is quietest.

config.label: Fan level
config.hint: 0 keeps the chamber coolest, with the exhaust always on and loudest. 1 is quietest: the chamber runs warmer, closer to the softening temperature, and the exhaust may stop. 0.5 sits in between.
